active_gate_evidence: Eight temporary-input census check exercise the real bptk inspect surface: middleware import warning, clean handle routing, SafeDisc loader-string refusal, SafeDisc sibling-artifact refusal, proprietary-codec refusal, Build engine routing, id Tech 1 engine routing, and honest no-match reporting.
